sections.theory:
Target and Field Games

Long Jump

Rules of the long jump

The turn of players will be fixed by drawing lots.

If more than eight players take part in the competition, then every player will be given three turns, and the best 8 players will be given 3, 3 more turns. In case of equality at the eighth position the concerned players will be given 3, 3 more attempts.

When the competition starts, players will not be allowed to use the runway for practice.

Before the competition starts, 2, 2 turns will be given for practice under the supervision of the judges.

Every player will be given the benefit of the correct attempt.

Every player will be given a chest number.

Every player will jump on his own turn.

Failures

If beyond the take-off line there comes the mark of the player’s foot on the sand or plasticine (Plasticine) while running or jumping.

Jumping without one’s turn.

Jumping without the chest number.

If the player takes off from outside the right or left edge of the take-off board, whether the foot is ahead of or behind the line of the board.

If the player, after completing the jump, walks backwards in the pit.

ہر کھلاڑی کو چسٹ نمبر دیا جائے گا۔

ہر کھلاڑی اپنی باری پر جمپ کرے گا۔

چسٹ نمبر کے بغیر جمپ کرنا۔

اگر کھلاڑی ٹیک آف بورڈ کے دائیں یا بائیں کنارے کے باہر سے ٹیک آف لے خواہ پاؤں بورڈ کی سیدھ سے آگے یا پیچھے ہی رہے۔

له خپل واره پرته ټوپ وهل.

Every player will jump on his own turn.

Failures

If the player takes off from outside the right or left edge of the take-off board, whether the foot is ahead of or behind the line of the board.
